sentences.en: Lisa's preference for classical music was not shared by Mark.
sentences.zh: 莉莎喜爱古典音乐，但马克并不这么认为。

sentences.en: Fascists are enabled by liberals' preference for abstractions over people.
sentences.zh: 法西斯主义是由于自由派更倾向于抽象概念而忽视人的利益所助长的。

sentences.en: I have the right to keep my voting preferences secret.
sentences.zh: 我有权保密我的投票偏好。

senses.zh: 偏爱，偏好；更喜欢的人（或物）；优待，优先（权）；<法律>（尤指债务偿付）优先偿还权
